The Research and Development Committee (RDC) at Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Hyderabad, is pleased to announce the successful completion of a lecture on “Technical and Proposal Writing.” The event was held on August 30, 2023, and was conducted with an aim to enrich the research capabilities of our students and faculty.

## Lecture Highlights

Speaker Profile:The lecture was graced by Prof. M.P. Gururajan from IIT Bombay, a renowned researcher with extensive experience in various research projects under DRDO and DST, Govt. of India.
Focus Areas:The lecture covered:
- Structuring a research paper
- Methods for clear and concise documentation
- Effective presentation of research results and outcomes
Inauguration and Welcome:The event was inaugurated by Prof. G. ChandraMohan Reddy, Principal of MGIT. Dr. Phaniraj, RDC-Director, warmly welcomed Prof. Gururajan to the lecture.
Attendance:The lecture was well-attended by IV B.Tech students and faculty members from various departments.
Closing Remarks:Dr. P. Chandra Shekar, Deputy Director, RDC, concluded the session with a vote of thanks.

## Outcome and Future Prospects

This session was an invaluable opportunity for the MGIT community to sharpen their skills in technical and proposal writing. Armed with the knowledge and insights gained, students and faculty are better equipped to draft high-quality research papers and proposals, thereby enriching their academic and professional journeys.
We extend our heartfelt thanks to Prof. Gururajan for imparting his wisdom and to all the attendees for making this event a success.
For more updates on upcoming lectures and workshops, stay tuned toour events page.
